title: Nyarlathotep

[[Image:Nyarlathotep.png|right|160px]]
'''Nyarlathotep''' is an [[Ancient One]].  He first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Sheet info==
'''Combat rating''': -4

'''Defenses''': [[Magical Resistance]]

'''Worshippers''': Nyarlathotep has innumerable cults all over the world.  [[Cultist]]s have the [[Endless]] ability.

'''Power''': A Thousand Masks - At the start of the game add the 5 [[Mask]] monsters to the cup.  Multiple Mask monsters can be in play at once.

'''Start of Battle''': Any [[investigator]] with no [[Clue token]]s is [[devour]]ed.

'''Attack''': Each investigator must pass a [[Lore check|Lore (+1) check]] or lose 1 Clue token.  Any investigator with no Clue tokens left is devoured.  This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

'''Doom Track''': 11

==Mythos Source==
Nyarlathotep is first mentioned in the prose poem ''Nyarlathotep'' (1920), written by H.P. Lovecraft. The first piece of fiction to feature him is ''The Rats in the Walls'' (1924), also written by H.P. Lovecraft.
